title: Add plural rules, locale fallback and number formatting to i18n
prompt: The tiny i18n module in this project only looks up string messages for the current locale. Extend it as described in README.md ("To add"): plural messages selected with `Intl.PluralRules`, a locale fallback chain, and locale-aware number formatting in interpolation. Existing behaviour for plain string messages must stay. Run the tests with `npm test`.
